Issue 36 · Design plan

Implementation plan · P1 · 3 days

Design the shell contract once.

Turn the approved Quiet Heritage baseline into review evidence that Product Design can approve and frontend issue 37 can implement without guessing.

STATUS · PENDINGMODE · HARDSCOPE · HOLDBRANCH · MAIN

One authority, one approval trail

The repository already contains the visual system. This plan closes the implementation-facing gaps, packages them for review, and keeps production Expo work with the frontend owner.

Outcome

Deliver: a non-normative offline review board, approved contract deltas in docs/design-guidelines.md, and a dated PO handoff record.

Prove: semantic mappings, WCAG contrast, responsive shell modes at five widths, component state coverage, keyboard and focus behavior, and scope integrity.

Boundary

No production shell. No app routes, theme code, APIs, authentication, calculations, persistence, or Phase 2 product capability.

Design simulations are allowed when clearly labeled. Parent feature 7 remains open for implementation and end-to-end acceptance.

Three linked decisions

Each phase produces evidence required by the next. No phase is complete merely because its artifact exists.

PHASE 03 · P1 · 1D

Status: PendingDepends on: Phases 1 and 2File: dated PO review report

Gate: no blocking comment, contradiction, or unsafe outbound content remains.

Approval is part of the architecture

The design guideline stays authoritative. Proposed decisions move through evidence, Product Owner review, reconciliation, and a separately approved external handoff.

What must pass

The plan is eligible for execution only because repository verification found no failed or unverified claims. Implementation still needs these mechanical and human gates.

GateEvidencePass condition
ContractIssue-to-guideline matrixEvery criterion is owned and cited.
ContrastNumeric color-pair results4.5:1 body; 3:1 large text and UI.
Responsive360, 375, 768, 1024, 1440 evidence rowsNo overflow; stable labels and hierarchy.
AccessibilityKeyboard, focus, text scale, motion, offline resultsEvery path works without pointer or motion.
ScopeUnstaged, staged, untracked inventoriesNo production path is changed.
PublicationAuth preflight, redacted draft, explicit approvalNo local path, private note, or personal data leaves the workspace.

Decisions held for PO

  • Recommended rail threshold: 768px.
  • Recommended sidebar threshold: 1024px.
  • MD3 direct roles versus project extensions.
  • Exact state anatomy and global ownership.

Required #37 gaps: force the approved light baseline and restore compliant Android predictive-back behavior, or obtain approved exceptions.

Evidence and open questions

Open questions: none for planning. Proposed design decisions are intentionally held for execution-time PO review.
